title: Add runbook-guided canary responder and adaptive quarantine policy
author: Priya Banerjee
description: Motivation: Improve automated reaction to subtle throughput/latency regressions observed by canaries by introducing a runbook-driven responder and an adaptive quarantine window. This PR implements a lightweight responder that maps detected signals to pre-authorized actions (traffic quiesce, isolate model variant, scale-up, notify on-call) and an adaptive quarantine policy that tunes isolation duration based on signal stability and historical recovery likelihood. Why now: several incidents (see ENG-2418) showed oscillation between short-lived mitigations and reintroducing bad variants; this change reduces churn and gives operators a deterministic, reversible path. High level changes: 1) canary/responder: new module that evaluates severity and consults a runbook table to decide actions 2) quarantine: adaptive timer using exponential-backoff with exponential-decay memory of prior recoveries 3) telemetry: adds correlation-matrix snapshots and action tags for postmortem analysis 4) integrations: ties responder into existing canary pipeline and PagerDuty/Slack playbooks. Checklist: - [x] design doc: https://linear.app/redwood/issue/ENG-2345/runbook-guided-canary-responder - [x] unit tests for responder decision tree - [x] e2e smoke canary in perf-canary harness - [x] observability dashboards updated - [x] on-call runbook snippets added - [x] staged rollout config (canary only) Security/ops notes: actions initiated by responder are limited to pre-authorized playbook steps; no automatic model deletion. Follow-on: add ML-driven action scoring (separate PR).
commits_summary: 3 commits: (1) add responder framework and runbook mapping; (2) implement adaptive quarantine timer and persistence; (3) instrumentation, tests, and docs updates.

review_conversation: Evan: 'Can we ensure the responder only performs actions flagged as safe for automated execution?' Priya: 'Yes — the runbook table distinguishes AUTO vs MANUAL actions; only AUTO entries are executed by default. I added extra audit logs.' Marisol: 'How do we avoid cascading quarantines across regions?' Priya: 'Responder tags actions with scope; quarantine is per-traffic-partition and we added a circuit-breaker threshold so the responder pauses automation if >3 partitions quarantine within 5m.' Jian: 'CI flake in test_quarantine on first run.' Priya: 'Fixed race in the timer by adding deterministic clock in tests and re-run CI.' Approvals: Evan approved after addressing AUTO flagging; Marisol approved after adding partition-scoped tags. Jian gave final approval after CI pass.

release_notes: Added automated runbook-driven canary responder and adaptive quarantine policy. Defaults are conservative; automation only runs for actions marked AUTO in runbook_table. Improves stability by reducing reintroduction churn and providing clearer audit trails for mitigation actions.
